test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: New sieds are made through pollination.
New seeds are made through polination.
New seeds are made through pollination.
New seeds are made throuhg pollination.

solution:
The correct answer is **'New seeds are made through pollination.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "pollination"** is **correctly spelt** in this sentence.
 
• **Pollination** refers to the process in which pollen is taken from one plant or part of a plant to another so that new plant seeds can be produced.
 
 
• Example - Many species of tree depend on the wind for pollination. 
 
 
 
• The **other** sentences** contain misspelt **words.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'New seeds are made through pollination.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "New sieds are made through pollination." (**Spelling error:** "sieds" should be "seeds.")
 
• "New seeds are made through polination." (**Spelling error: **"polination" should be "pollination.")
 
• "New seeds are made throuhg pollination." (**Spelling error:** "throuhg" should be "through.")
